evidence.reason: Line 589 states the tripwire fires when a `tool_call` reaches `in_progress`, `completed`, or `failed` "before any permission request" without scoping that request to the same tool call. Since the tripwire tracks permission requests per `toolCallId`, a request for one tool call does not clear another; the sentence is therefore inaccurate and the suggested one-line clarification is the smallest compatible documentation fix.
